environment.hint: Live means connected API access, not necessarily production business data. Each source's environment is identified separately.
environment.test: Test environment: real provider API, test data only—not production business activity.
environment.unknown: Environment unconfirmed: do not assume these are production business data.
environment.testReport: This report includes test-account data. Its metrics and Growth Score must not be presented as production business results.
sample.case: Synthetic case: AI Customer Support Agent · 2026-07-01–2026-07-31. MRR is the month-end snapshot; ROAS and CAC use this month's ad results.
connections.savedNotVerified: Saved credentials are not proof of access. Check each connection in this session; checks are not retained after refresh. Google sign-in does not connect your business accounts.
connections.storage.missing: No saved credentials in this workspace; add your own below.
connections.storage.expired: Stored credentials expired; save fresh credentials before checking.
connections.storage.unavailable: Credential storage is unavailable; saved status cannot be confirmed.
connections.storage.server_environment: Configured by the local server; not a saved workspace credential
growth.live.periodPolicy: All sources use the same inclusive dates, ending before today in every source timezone. Their calendar-day boundaries are local to each account, not identical UTC instants.
growth.live.periodUnknown: A common reporting-period policy was not supplied. Check each source below.
growth.live.timezoneUnavailable: The account reporting timezone could not be verified. Check account access in Connections and retry; no timezone was assumed.
growth.live.mrrSnapshot: MRR is a current subscription snapshot, not cash collected during the reporting period. A missing MRR does not erase available revenue or ad results.
growth.live.fractionalAmounts: Monthly normalization and source calculations may produce fractional currency units, including for JPY or KRW. They are preserved here; no currency conversion is performed.
growth.live.mrrPolicy: MRR policy net_recurring_v1: monthly-normalized licensed subscriptions in active or past_due status, in the selected currency, after supported permanent discounts. Temporary discounts, unsupported prices or incomplete subscription details make MRR unavailable. This is not guaranteed to match Stripe Dashboard's configurable MRR.
growth.live.mrrPolicyUnknown: MRR calculation policy was not supplied; do not assume parity with Stripe Dashboard.
growth.live.mrrWarningSubscriptions: Subscription data was unavailable. Check Stripe read permissions.
growth.live.mrrWarningItems: Not all subscription items were available.
growth.live.mrrWarningTiered: Tiered subscription prices are not supported by this MRR policy.
growth.live.mrrWarningDiscountDetails: Discount details were missing or not expanded.
growth.live.mrrWarningDiscount: A discount cannot be calculated under this MRR policy.
growth.live.mrrWarningTemporaryDiscount: Temporary discounts require a different MRR policy; no amount was guessed.
growth.live.mrrWarningPrice: A recurring price or billing interval is unsupported.
growth.live.mrrWarningTax: Tax-inclusive subscription prices are not supported by this MRR policy.
growth.live.mrrWarningCustomerDiscount: Customer-level discount details were unavailable, so net MRR cannot be confirmed.
growth.live.mrrWarningLookupLimit: The bounded discount-check budget was reached. MRR remains incomplete.
growth.live.mrrWarningDiscountUnavailabl: Discount details could not be read. Check Stripe permissions and retry.
growth.live.mrrWarningUnknown: Some subscription data could not be calculated safely; MRR is incomplete.
growth.live.currencyMismatch: The combined Growth score requires Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts with the same currency. Automatic FX conversion is unavailable; individual connection checks remain available.
connections.currencyMismatch: The account currency differs from the saved reporting currency. Update this connection to the actual account currency and test again.
auth.expiredBody: Your Live session could not be authorized. Sign in again to reopen your own workspace; no account data will be loaded until access is confirmed.
live.authRequired: Your session needs verification. Sign in again before accessing your connected accounts.
live.serviceUnavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later; no successful read is being claimed.
live.quota: The current usage limit has been reached. Please retry after the limit resets.
home.live.configurationOnly: Configured does not mean tested. Check each source in Connections, then explicitly load a report in Growth. Opening Today does not read paid provider data.
growth.live.missingSources: Still required: {sources}. Connect these sources before loading the combined report.
growth.live.configurationOnly: The combined report requires Stripe, Google Ads and Meta Ads. Saved credentials do not prove access: test each connection first. Other features can use their own sources independently.
growth.live.configurationIssue: The report cannot use the current account configuration. Check missing connections, selected currencies and account permissions, then retry.
growth.live.previousReport: Refresh failed; the last successful report is shown below.
growth.live.auditUnavailable: Activity history could not be refreshed. This does not invalidate a successfully loaded report; the history shown may be older.
growth.live.auditNotSaved: The report was read successfully, but its activity record was not saved. Do not repeat the provider read just to recover history.
growth.live.currencyNote: Amounts retain each source’s currency. Stripe MRR includes only the selected currency; ad currencies must match their accounts. No FX conversion or cross-currency totals are performed.
connections.currencyFieldHint: Enter the 3-letter code, such as USD, CNY or EUR. Use the actual ad account currency; Stripe includes only this selected currency.
connections.currencyHint: Set each business source’s currency explicitly. The combined Growth score requires matching Google Ads and Meta Ads currencies. Amounts are not converted or added across currencies; a saved connection is not proof of a successful live read.
connections.configurationUnavailable: Configuration could not be applied. Check the account and currency settings; the credential service may also be temporarily unavailable.
connections.refreshFailed: The operation completed, but the latest connection status could not be loaded. The status above may be outdated. Retry status only; do not repeat the save or disconnect.
auth.loginTitle: Sign in to use your own accounts
auth.loginBody: Continue with Google to open your private Live workspace. Connect your accounts after signing in; sample accounts are never reused.
auth.verifyBody: Use a Google account with a verified email. If your session could not be checked, retry or choose another account.
auth.loginHint: Sign in to connect your accounts
auth.readOnly: Live reads your connected data. This prototype does not change ads, campaigns or budgets.
auth.popupPending: Complete sign-in in the Google window. This wait will end automatically if the window does not respond.
auth.browserHint: If no sign-in window appears, open this site in Chrome or Safari and allow popups, then try again.
auth.error: Sign-in could not be completed. Allow the Google sign-in window, check your connection, then retry.
connections.privateHint: Connections belong to your signed-in workspace. Save read-only credentials, then check each source independently.
connections.vertexLinkedHint: This workspace already has a linked project identity. No API key is needed to check or use this connection. The fields below are only for replacing it with your own API-key configuration; disconnecting revokes this workspace's linked access.
connections.vertexReplacementKey: Vertex AI API key (only to replace the linked connection)
connections.invalid: Check the required account fields, credential type and read-only permissions, then save again.
connections.configuredOnly: Configuration saved; a live read has not been verified.
connections.testFailed: The live check failed. Check this source’s credentials, account access and permissions.
connections.googleOAuthRefreshFailed: Google OAuth could not refresh the access token. Confirm that the client ID, client secret and refresh token belong to the same OAuth client, then reauthorize and save.
connections.googleAccountAccessFailed: OAuth succeeded, but Google Ads denied this customer ID. Confirm the authorized user can view it; if access is through a manager account, enter the manager customer ID. Newly approved Explorer access may also need time to propagate.
connections.googleUserAccessFailed: OAuth succeeded, but the authorized Google user has no Google Ads account access. Reauthorize with a user who can view the target account.
connections.googleScopeFailed: OAuth is missing the Google Ads scope. Reauthorize with the adwords scope and save the new refresh token.
connections.googleProjectAccessFailed: OAuth succeeded, but its Cloud project cannot yet access this Ads account. Confirm Explorer or higher API access and retry after the new access propagates.
connections.googleDeveloperTokenHint: Leave this blank. Since September 9, 2026, Google Ads ignores developer tokens. This optional field only accepts older configurations. API access is determined by the Google Cloud project that owns your OAuth credentials; valid OAuth access and Ads account permission are still required.
connections.googleAccessHint: An access token expires. Replace it when expired or use OAuth credentials for refreshable access.
live.requestError: The live request could not be completed. Check Connections and verify each required source, then try again.
growth.live.googleAuthFailed: Google Ads could not authenticate: its token has expired or account permission is missing. Update the Google Ads connection and check it again. Use complete OAuth refresh credentials for renewable access; signing into GrowthOS again will not renew the Ads token.
growth.live.stripeAuthFailed: Stripe rejected its saved credentials. Check the restricted key and read permissions in Connections, then test Stripe again.
growth.live.metaAuthFailed: Meta Ads rejected its saved credentials. Check the token, account access and ads_read permission in Connections, then test Meta Ads again.
live.sourceError: This source could not return data. Check its connection, credentials and access permissions.

mode.unavailableHint: We could not confirm which workspace modes this server supports. Retry when the connection is available.

customers.liveNone: No usable search results were found.

visibility.noSources: Connect ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity to run a check.

connections.aiHint: How AI assistants see your brand.
connections.geminiAlternativesHint: Google AI Studio and Vertex AI are two ways to connect the same Gemini source. Configure either one; Gemini counts once, not twice.
connections.geminiRoutingHint: This selector only opens a method's settings; it does not change or delete saved credentials. Checks and disconnection apply only to the selected method. Visibility uses Vertex AI when both are configured, otherwise the configured method.
connections.serverManaged: Configured on the server by your admin.
